repo_zh: 一次提交可以触发多次执行。沿一件任务从入队到重试的路径，观察线程之间传递了哪些信息。最后比较独立的浏览器工具如何为请求设置时间预算。
repo_en: One submission can trigger several attempts. Follow a job from enqueue to retry, then compare the independent browser client’s timeout policy.

task_queue.py.en: Thread-pool task queue: priority scheduling with backoff retries

frontend.js.en: Browser helpers: debounce, timeout/retry API client, polling

title.en: How does a job enter the queue?

body.zh: 假设两个线程同时提交到期时间相同的任务。队列先比较到期时间，再比较锁内分配的序号，因此无需比较两个函数对象。调用方在任务入队后就可以继续工作。
body.en: Suppose two threads submit jobs with the same deadline. The tie-breaking sequence number is assigned under a lock, so the queue never has to compare callable objects. The caller can proceed as soon as the job is queued.

refs.zh: 看队列条目的三个字段
refs.en: Inspect the three fields of a queue entry

body.zh: 工作线程取出最早到期的条目。若时机未到，这个线程持有任务并等待；真正调用函数时，它从任务对象恢复原始参数。
body.en: A worker takes the earliest queued entry. If it is early, that worker holds the job while waiting. Once due, it invokes the callable with the original arguments.

body.zh: 设初始重试次数为 2。第一次失败后还剩 1 次计数，代码计算出 4 秒延迟并重新入队。新的队列条目有自己的完成计数，旧条目在 finally 中结清。
body.en: With a retry budget of two, the first failure reduces the counter to one and schedules a fresh entry four seconds later. That entry has its own completion count. The finally block accounts for the attempt that just ended.

refs.zh: 追踪剩余次数与重新入队
refs.en: Follow the retry budget and resubmission

title.en: How does the browser bound waiting?

body.zh: 浏览器工具独立运行。一次 request 的所有尝试共用一个中止信号和计时器；重试等待也消耗这份时间预算。对照工作线程，每次重新入队都会得到新的到期时间。
body.en: The browser helper runs independently. Every attempt within one request shares an abort signal and a timer, so backoff consumes the same deadline. The worker queue, by contrast, assigns each resubmission its own due time.
